spell.fire_bolt.flavor: A pinched coal-spark loosed down a copper-bound ley-line.
spell.fireball.flavor: Pressurized tallow-gas and sulfur igniting in a tight red bloom.
spell.flame_burst.flavor: Three splintered embers seeking dry wool, oiled leather, and flesh.
spell.ignite.flavor: Slow pitch-flame that clings to wet cloth and chars bone beneath.
spell.frost_bolt.flavor: A needle of cistern-ice drawn from winter's deep pressure.
spell.ice_storm.flavor: Sleet and jagged hail sheared from the upper mountain winds.
spell.chain_frost.flavor: Cold leaps from damp cloak to damp cloak like river-freeze.
spell.healing.flavor: Warmth coaxed back into torn sinew with a steady pulse of mana.
spell.healing_rain.flavor: Clean mountain mist that washes grime and fever from the line.
spell.lightning.flavor: A grounded arc of telluric current snapping to iron helms.
spell.chain_lightning.flavor: High-voltage discharge hopping across wet mail and raised pikes.
spell.haste.flavor: Tightens the breath and quickens tired legs before the breach.
spell.gale.flavor: A bitter marsh squall that fouls bowstrings and staggers shields.
spell.wind_ward.flavor: A humming pressure-shell that turns aside slung stone and bolt.
spell.rock_throw.flavor: Basalt wrenched from the earth and hurled with siege-arm force.
spell.stone_curse.flavor: Calcifies joint and marrow until a soldier stands as limestone.
spell.stone_skin.flavor: Hardens bruised hide with a crust of compressed quarry-slate.
spell.poison_cloud.flavor: Stagnant peat-fume and copperas drifting low over the mud.
spell.quake.flavor: Strikes the bedrock seam until palisades and kneecaps buckle.
spell.blessing.flavor: Steadies the sword-hand with a cold oath of the First Watch.
spell.weaken.flavor: Bleeds iron-will from the limbs like a cracked tallow lamp.
spell.resurrect.flavor: Reclaims a fresh corpse under Third-Dynasty probate bone-law.
spell.corpse_burst.flavor: Ruptures trapped gas in a fallen carcass, scything nearby foes.
spell.meditation.flavor: Slows the pulse to draw stray current from the damp earth.
spell.meteor.flavor: Calls down white-hot caldera slag to crush shield-walls flat.
spell.inferno.flavor: Unleashes pent-up furnace draft across five choked targets.
spell.blizzard.flavor: Buries a whole crossing in blinding sleet and frostbite.
spell.thunderstorm.flavor: Four merciless sky-bolts hunting every copper buckle in range.
spell.iron_skin.flavor: Plates the body in tempered slag-sheen that turns keen steel.
spell.acid_rain.flavor: Vitriol-laced drizzle that pits iron plate and blisters skin.
spell.mana_burn.flavor: Shorts an enemy caster's ward-coil, scorching mind and marrow.
spell.time_warp.flavor: Overclocks the blood-beat until arrows seem to crawl in air.
spell.shield_bash.flavor: Drives an iron rim into jaw and ribs to break the guard.
spell.cleave_arc.flavor: A wide two-handed sweep meant to clear three pikemen at once.
spell.hamstring_cut.flavor: Low blade-work aimed behind the greave to lame a fleeing foe.
spell.sunder_plate.flavor: Heavy overhead impact that splits rivets and dents breastplates.
spell.grit_through_pain.flavor: Bites down on leather, binds the rag, and keeps standing.
spell.whirlwind_maul.flavor: A spinning iron storm that punishes any pack closing in.
spell.executioners_blow.flavor: Measured, merciless weight brought down to end a wounded man.
spell.bodkin_shot.flavor: Narrow square-headed iron punched straight through chain links.
spell.volley_of_reeds.flavor: A whistling sheaf of shafts dropped behind raised pavises.
spell.heartseeker.flavor: One held breath, one true release, aimed for the gorget gap.
spell.cinder_lance.flavor: A narrow jet of furnace-flame that pierces shield and surcoat.
spell.brine_frost.flavor: Salt-chilled slush that locks boots fast to the cobbles.
spell.static_arc.flavor: A short blue snap from knuckles primed with crushed quartz.
spell.peat_gas_blast.flavor: Ignites pocketed bog-vapor in a sudden, concussive thump.
spell.siphon_ley.flavor: Taps an enemy's stray charge to feed your own dry wards.
spell.vitrify.flavor: Melts sand, iron, and flesh into dark translucent slag.
spell.marrow_dart.flavor: A sharpened femur-splinter loosed with cold probate precision.
spell.grave_chill.flavor: Exhales cellar-cold air from an unsealed ossuary vault.
